Top-line: TrailCraft builds an in-app onboarding copilot for SMB clients (walkthroughs + context-aware tips). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API for fast time-to-value; plan POC to validate streaming latency and tool-calling reliability. Mid-market procurement — likely move to Dedicated after 3-month POC if latency/SLOs and cost caps hold.

Sales/ops: asked for hosted pricing with burst allowance and an optional dedicated sizing quote. Wants model fallback policy (smaller model for best-effort when primary capacity constrained). Very cost sensitive on long-run per-token unit economics.

Artifacts: drive links + fireflies attached. High-level demo feedback: streaming looks good on dev env but inconsistent tool-calls under test load. Next demo will include SE-run load test and a canary routing scenario.

requirements_summary: Build in-app onboarding copilot that streams token-level updates to UX, supports tool calling for product lookups, enforces per-user token caps, and meets a 95th percentile latency SLO <= 350ms under expected peak. Priority: deterministic response time and predictable monthly spend. Secondary: model recommendations for cheaper gen when context small; prefix caching. Long-term: Dedicated reserved capacity and VPC option for compliance customers.

Token cost caps are non-negotiable; we must be able to set hard limits per session and alerts on burn rate.

Offer Redwood Optimize review during POC to suggest batching/caching quantization profiles to hit cost targets.
